Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing and network/data-risk review of MiTeC Network Scanner 6.1.0; no payload executed and no network scanned

ProductPage.PublishedBehavior: Multithreaded ICMP, TCP/UDP port, IP, NetBIOS/NetBT, Active Directory and SNMP scanner; ping sweeps, shares/services, SSDP/UPnP, WS-Discovery and mDNS. Publisher lists data including IP/MAC, device/domain, logged user, OS/BIOS/model/CPU, services, sessions, open files, running processes, terminal sessions, event logs, installed software, SAM accounts and WMI queries. Results can be edited/saved/loaded/exported as CSV; local IP range can be auto-detected; a VirusTotal domain report link is offered.
ProductPage.OperatingSystems: Publisher lists Windows XP-11 and Server 2003-2025; this is not RIDE target acceptance.
ProductPage.LicenseObservation: The product page lists a paid lifetime single-user license at EUR 30 on the review date. The support EULA separately says trial/unregistered software is freeware for non-commercial usage and lists license types. No local entitlement or redistribution conclusion is inferred.

TermsPage.Observation: Current publisher EULA and product-page paid license information remain separate; local intended-use rights and redistribution are unresolved.

PinnedArtifact.ArchiveMemberSet: Two x86/x64 executable variants; no license, README or notice member recorded by the frozen inventory.

ReviewFindings: The current page and frozen archive/page/member hashes match the inventory. Both executables report FileVersion 6.1.0.0 but ProductVersion 6.0.0.0; preserve this metadata distinction. Hashes and PE metadata do not verify runtime behavior or target support.

The published scan surface can enumerate hosts and expose account, process, share, service, event-log, installed-software and network details. Exact scan authorization, network destinations/rates, credentials, exported CSV handling and VirusTotal link behavior are not established by the page.

Future behavior acceptance must be limited to a deliberately isolated, owned test network with disposable synthetic endpoints/accounts and explicit port/traffic bounds. Do not auto-detect or scan the host's real local range, query directory/SAM data, or use production credentials, endpoints or exported results.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Current version, separate x86/x64 variants, published scan/export surface and license boundary are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Local entitlement, scan authorization/traffic, credential handling, CSV sensitivity, VirusTotal behavior, GUI and activation remain unverified.
Deferred: Owner-specific MiTeC use and archive distribution assessment
No real network, local-range auto-detection, directory/SAM query or production credentials during acceptance
Any later network behavior test requires isolated owned endpoints, synthetic accounts, explicit port/traffic bounds and disposable CSV outputs
Windows target, UI and activation behavior through an approved guest workflow
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: Published feature and data scope is clearer, but rights, network behavior and a complete legacy outcome remain open; no estimate deduction is justified.
